lines: omg you're FINALLY on here 😭
{first}!!! you made a profile!! I'm so proud of you 😭
your profile is giving witness protection. 0 connections, no posts, not one photo of you holding a giant cheque.
0 connections. ZERO. even my nan has 40 and she thinks this is a dating site.
ok. let me sort you out.
done. introduced you to everyone I know.
done. introduced you to everyone I know. well. everyone who still replies to me.
your feed should wake up now. like everything. comment 'Congrats!' on everything. it's the law.

Delighted to introduce my oldest friend {me}! 🎉 We've been through a lot together: a group project, a flat with a ghost, and a 5-a-side final we don't talk about. {first} is looking for a role where getting hit is part of the job. Please connect! 🙏
Some personal news: my best friend {me} is finally on here! 🎉 Reliable, punctual, and can take a chair to the back like nobody I've ever met. Recruiters, you know what to do. 🙏
Hi {first}, I came across your profile and I think you'd be a GREAT fit for a Brawler role at {company}. 🚀
Hi {first}! Your profile popped up in my search for 'available, durable'. I think you'd be a GREAT fit for a Brawler role at {company}. 🚀
It's a group interview: two of you against two of ours, in the {arena}. Bring a friend!
Hit Easy Apply when you're ready. It's very easy. That's the whole point.
wait. a GROUP interview?? I'm in.
did someone say GROUP interview. I'm in. I'm already in my interview trainers.
I've been training. I've watched a video. most of a video.
I've been training. I did a plank yesterday. a whole one.
see you on the job card 🥊
WE DID IT. did we? I was on the floor for most of it. great view of the ceiling tiles.
ok that was AMAZING. I've never been hit by a stranger before. very freeing.
same again? I've told my manager I'm 'at the dentist'.
ok don't be mad.
a guy called Gavin slid into my DMs. he says I have 'founder energy'.
I'm Head of Vibes at a DAO now. I don't know what a DAO is. nobody does. that's the vibe.
I'm Head of Vibes at a DAO now. I asked what a DAO is and he said 'exactly'.
you'll be fine on your own. you were always the one who got hit the most anyway 💛

Thrilled to announce I'm starting a new position as Head of Vibes at a decentralised autonomous organisation! 🚀 Huge thanks to {me} for the brawls, the bruises and the lift home. Gavin, let's make history (on the blockchain).

Personal news: after two whole fights in the brawling industry, I'm pivoting to Web3 as Head of Vibes. 🚀 {first}, you taught me everything I know about getting up off the floor. Gavin says that's 'basically crypto'.
Short-staffed? 🙋 Temporarily Yours sends a warm body to any fight, from 💵 {tempcost}.
Our temps turn up. Mostly. They don't level up, they don't learn, and they don't ask questions. Book them on the job card.
Or fight alone. We respect a founder.
Hi {first}! Karen from Talent Acquisition 👋
I see you've spent 💵 {tempspend} on temps so far. Temps are a cost. People are an investment. 🚀
Quick one: temps are a cost. People are an investment. 🚀 (Also temps are a cost. You've spent 💵 {tempspend} on them.)
Hiring is open for you now: one seat on your squad, from 💵 {hirecost}. Hires level up, learn moves and remember your birthday. Temps have called people 'boss', 'mate' and, once, 'Dad'.
Looking forward to our final interview, {first}.
I hear you've been interviewing around, {first}. Ours is the final one.
Bring a pen. You'll need it to sign your resignation.
Bring a CV. I'll need something to wipe the floor with afterwards.
You beat {lastboss}?! I've updated your file from 'Brave' to 'Promising'. ✨
That opens a second seat on your squad. Fill it with someone who grows.
Oh, and expect a letter. Someone downstairs wants to make you an offer.
